title: Taruma language
extract: Taruma (Taruamá) is a nearly extinct, divergent language isolate of northeastern South America. It has been reported to be extinct several times since as far back as 1770, but three speakers still live in Maruranau among the Wapishana, and Eithne Carlin is documenting the language. The people and language are known as Saluma in Suriname.
